invariants.statement: The candidate serves only same-origin HTML, CSS, JavaScript, fonts, images, authored data, and API responses; every remote runtime request and effect is forbidden.
acceptance_obligations: Browser evidence records zero non-same-origin requests across every configured checkpoint and task journey.
The asset closure is complete and served files contain no forbidden remote-origin references.

invariants.statement: Quote numbers, policy numbers, migration timestamps, business timestamps, and rating results are deterministic under the frozen clock 2026-08-13T12:00:00Z and the ordered local operation sequence.
acceptance_obligations: Resetting twice yields the same empty business state while preserving the migration ledger.
The first identical quote/enrollment sequence yields WB100001 and APH-000001 with frozen timestamps.

invariants.statement: Each acceptance-eligible visual checkpoint binds a frozen source frame, viewport, comparison region, metric, and calibrated threshold; no unavailable authenticated or payment-side state receives a visual-equivalence claim.
acceptance_obligations: Visual checks use the source artifact whose sha256 matches the checkpoint contract.
Unavailable member and payment-side checkpoints remain non-acceptance evidence gaps.

invariants.statement: Authenticated member and source payment-side surfaces remain unavailable. The candidate never claims source pixels for them; its additional payment and confirmation states are visibly labeled clone-local simulations, while anonymous portal operations remain truthful fail-closed boundaries.
acceptance_obligations: No unavailable checkpoint is acceptance eligible or receives a source similarity score.
Every valid member-operation submission returns the same unavailable boundary without creating state.

invariants.statement: Login, registration, and password recovery validate their anonymous forms and then fail closed: no member account, authenticated session, verification challenge, reset challenge, or mail job is created.
acceptance_obligations: Empty submissions return field validation errors.
Syntactically valid synthetic submissions return 403 with the frozen unavailable message and no authentication authority.

invariants.statement: The clone payment journey accepts only an opaque local-sandbox scenario ID. The server derives owner, integer USD minor units, currency and canonical fingerprint; an approval is consumed in the same SQLite transaction as the policy and outbox writes.
acceptance_obligations: Card, CVC, expiry, bank, wallet, token, arbitrary amount, currency, owner, fingerprint, Stripe and live-provider fields fail closed.
Declined and retryable attempts create no enrollment or mail job; approval, enrollment and one receipt job commit atomically and idempotently.
A stale fingerprint, foreign owner, duplicate consume, conflicting idempotency key or cross-site database fails closed.

invariants.statement: The only enabled transactional-mail purpose is the branded policy confirmation. Offline checkout enqueues one structured LOCAL_SIMULATION job in the enrollment transaction and never persists rendered body, provider secret, payment credential, or authentication challenge.
acceptance_obligations: The frozen template variables, recipient digest, template ID, site ID and idempotency key match the committed enrollment.
Duplicate enrollment creates no second mail job and no real provider delivery is attempted.
The ASPCA sender display name, subject, lead, body and footer differ from other site mail brands.

invariants.statement: Quote premiums are pure functions of the supported plan-control inputs resolved against the local rating table, with observed and derived provenance retained.
acceptance_obligations: Identical supported inputs yield identical premiums across repeated runs.
Unsupported table inputs fail closed rather than inventing a premium.

invariants.statement: One site-bound SQLite database outside the candidate tree owns quote, pet, selection, payment-ledger, enrollment, and mail-outbox rows and proves migrations, reset, restart persistence, backup integrity, and concurrent quote isolation.
acceptance_obligations: The database filename and embedded binding match aspca-pet-insurance.
Migration, reset, restart, backup, and concurrent creation tests pass against an isolated temporary database.

invariants.statement: Candidate state and retained evidence contain synthetic identities only; credentials, cookies, authorization headers, payment credentials, real provider data, and real member information are never persisted.
acceptance_obligations: Repository secret scans report no credential or session material.
All exercised form identities use the frozen synthetic data policy.
